modules.name: road_dynamic_low_io_top
modules.description: 38-bit runtime-loaded diagnostic shell for frozen dynamic serial postprocessing.

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Immediate assertion cancels all work, two rising edges release, reload table addresses 0..1023 before compute.

behavior: A000 followed by 1024 signed16 words loads the table sequentially.
B000 followed by 19 least-significant-first 16-bit words loads one 304-bit packet; only then submit.
Packet bits: accumulator95:0 pre191:96 shifts209:192 post241:210 shift247:242 activate248 mask251:249 tags299:252 fault300 padding303:301.
Each result transmits tag, signed16 data and flags (bit1 INT16, bit0 fault) in three accepted words; all hold under stall.
C000 transmits input count, output count, table/fault flags. D000 transmits counted SUBMIT/WAIT clocks low/high and flags.
Cycle counter excludes packet/table preload and TX clocks: diagnostic window, not full core latency or FPS.
No new MAC, DDR, board protocol or timing exception.
Only reg_release_done drives the internal async reset tree. Raw i_rstn still immediately masks RX ready and TX valid.
Two synchronizer DFFs, clock, ports, numeric core and load protocol remain unchanged. No attributes or timing exceptions.
Raw ASR recovery/removal still checked; a positive diagnostic result cannot establish asynchronous external signoff.
constraints: 100MHz PH1P35MDG324 -3 diagnostic only, automatic pins and zero I/O delays.
Parameters are runtime data, not constant coefficients. Existing round, SiLU and fault semantics retained.
Strict failures and external/removal timing failures remain unclosed.
corner_cases: Partial packet/table reset, running reset, random TX stall, counter wrap after 65535 batches.
verification_cases: 330 batches/604 outputs, partial load and running reset, payload hold, counts.
Near-edge release before/on/after edge; TABLE, PACKET, SUBMIT, WAIT and stalled TX reset; 1024-word reload; no stale output.
